finalText:
**Migration done.** 36 calls in 12 files moved to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

Files touched, by package:

| Package | Files |
|---|---|
| `accounts` | `session.js`, `teamService.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js` |
| `support` | `sla.js`, `macroAdmin.js` |
| `catalog` | `supplier.js`, `variantAdmin.js` |
| `billing` | `refund.js`, `couponService.js` |
| `orders` | `shipment.js`, `returnService.js` |
| `analytics` | `cohort.js` |

Two calls left in [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9). Its header says edits are lost on upgrade. Left alone. That needs an upstream fix or a wrapper. `cache.query` is a different API. Untouched.
